scope: Bounded four-minute screen of eight compact authored proposal records. No test, source-data access, readiness claim, idea addition, or registry mutation.

inspected.title: Semantic role must survive alternate raw readings
inspected.limitation: The proposed three-reading intersection depends on complete independent joins; it is not a remaining selection candidate.

inspected.title: A proposed role requires exclusion from incompatible slots
inspected.limitation: The incompatible-slot exclusion logic has an existing design review and requires independently frozen compatible/incompatible slots.

inspected.title: Candidate same-role wholes require reciprocal frame compatibility
inspected.limitation: Existing review correctly notes reciprocal observed frames are not necessary for a shared broad role.

inspected.title: A process operator whole selects action modality
inspected.limitation: GDT744/GDT745 expose channel/open-surface structure but no independently bound action/result annotations; action-before-result would therefore be an authored coding gate, not yet a less-shared discriminator.

inspected.title: Amount expressions attach to a measured entity
inspected.limitation: GDT760 reports zero confirmed lexemes and GDT804 reports zero clean GDT760 content contacts with the content slot unresolved; the proposed material-versus-operation contrast is not currently independently bound.

inspected.title: A transition whole denotes processed state change
inspected.limitation: The transition/state proposal has an existing processed-state countermodel review.

inspected.title: A closure whole predicts record release without new input
inspected.limitation: GDT791 supplies record-boundary/owner structure, but release without a new action is not an independently semantic endpoint; the same boundary can be shared by rival bookkeeping models.

inspected.title: Action fields preserve source-to-target order
inspected.limitation: Source-before-target ordering is compatible with ordinary layout and renderer order; without independently bound source/target relations it does not separate semantic rivals.

partial; open content roles, zero literal identities

conclusion: No remaining inspected proposal survives as a defensible next method-review nomination. The three apparently strongest semantic contrasts (IDEA000009, IDEA000010, IDEA000016) either require independent meaning/role bindings or are already shared by structural bookkeeping rivals. This is a bounded selection result, not a claim that the other uninspected proposals are invalid.
